answer: Propose a relic register that freezes N active slots at epoch entry. Each slot must lock N distinct units of timber collateral for 30 epochs; a ledger rejects reused coins and releases nectar only from a fixed reward pool. A farm can share one model and borrow coins, but k slots require at least k² locked units, even through separate lenders; financing them for 30 epochs is not free. A signed double-use or provably false attestation burns that slot’s lock; without the lock, its payout is zero.
